title: Bitcoin Analysis: How High Can This Rally Actually Go?
description:
Bitcoin is pushing higher and the rally is not over yet. But how much higher can this actually go? In this video I walk through the daily chart structure, show you the Fibonacci target zone between 82K and 94K, and then open two tools that flagged this April strength weeks before it happened. The cycle analyzer and seasonality data both pointed to an April window for upside, and I show you what they say about the weeks ahead.
